name: Tarai Foods Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Tarai Foods Ltd manufactures fresh, frozen and canned   
fruits & vegetables for domestic consumption.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
a) Frozen Green Peas
b) Frozen American sweet corn
c) Frozen mixed vegetables
d) Frozen French Fries
d) Fresh, frozen and canned Mushrooms.
Company manufactures and sells sweet corn to various distributors/Big Bazar Outlets in and around Delhi. Company is planning to launch French fries again in the market.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
